---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a library feature or documentation improvement
---

## Use case

Describe what you want to do and what currently prevents it.

## Suggested change

Describe the behavior or API you have in mind. An example token, facelet
layout, or Flix call helps when relevant.

## Compatibility

Say whether the proposal would change existing tokens, orbit or facelet order,
or the published format in `FORMAT.md`.
